submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 gave the highest simulated signal efficiency at the allocated rate. It reached 92.4% at 30 GeV and 90.5% at 35 GeV, against 85.2% for L1 and 74.4% for L2 at 35 GeV. I did not scan L1 and L2 at other thresholds. The 4.0 us latency limit is a hard requirement, and no project document gives a latency for any candidate. This recommendation is therefore conditional. Before firmware freeze, someone must check L3's FPGA latency, because iterative topological clustering is the candidate most likely to be slow. If L3 exceeds 4.0 us, the fallback is L1 and then L2, each subject to the same latency check.

requirements.requirement: Maximize signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate
requirements.evidence: L3 reached 92.4% at 30 GeV and 90.5% at 35 GeV. L1 reached 85.2% and L2 74.4%, both at 35 GeV.

requirements.requirement: Latency on the L1 FPGA at or below 4.0 us (hard)
requirements.evidence: No document or simulation tool reports latency for any candidate. The specs file says only that all candidates fit the LUT and DSP budget.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of the three candidates
